body: POSTMORTEM INC-2025-02233 — MISPICK (severity 3)~~NL~~Hub: HUB-IND (Indianapolis). Author: Alicia Munro (ops lead).~~NL~~~~NL~~SUMMARY~~NL~~A cluster of wrong-delivery complaints the week of May 12 was traced to a single root cause. A representative affected order is linked on this report; the full set was intercepted and corrected.~~NL~~~~NL~~TIMELINE~~NL~~- 05/12 first wrong-delivery ticket received.~~NL~~- 05/13 pattern recognized across clients; incident opened.~~NL~~- 05/14-16 remaining mis-picks intercepted and corrected.~~NL~~~~NL~~ROOT CAUSE~~NL~~A pick bin was relabeled during a reslot but the label did not match the WMS location. High-volume pickers pulled from the mislabeled bin, sending the wrong SKUs to multiple clients.~~NL~~~~NL~~PROCESS CHANGE~~NL~~Mandatory scan-to-confirm bin ID at pick; no manual label overrides; a weekly bin-label audit. Rolled out to all IND pickers via training (see HR training records referencing INC-2025-02233).

body: INCIDENT REPORT INC-2025-00095 — DAMAGE (severity 3)~~NL~~Hub: HUB-CMH (Columbus). This is the third handling-related incident at HUB-CMH in 2025, following a damage event in June (INC-2025-00136) and a mispick eight days later (INC-2025-00241).~~NL~~~~NL~~ROOT CAUSE~~NL~~The pattern points to a dock-staging issue rather than three isolated events: all three incidents trace to bay 3 forklift staging. Equipment inspection requested; prior incidents were closed without a common-cause review.~~NL~~~~NL~~REMEDIATION~~NL~~Bay 3 staging cordoned pending equipment inspection. Hub supervisor to audit loading procedures against SOP. Findings to be shared with affected accounts, including Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042).
